sentence: The company reduced Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions through energy efficiency projects.
Renewable electricity procurement increased during the reporting year.
Water consumption intensity decreased across operating sites.
The company assessed biodiversity risks around operating sites.
Employees received occupational health and safety training.
The company maintains a human rights policy for workers and suppliers.
The company expanded diversity and inclusion programs.
The board includes independent directors and an audit committee.
The code of conduct covers anti-corruption and whistleblowing.
The company strengthened data privacy and cybersecurity controls.
The company generated revenue from product sales during the year.
The board approved the annual financial statements.
